review: Scorecard: no new round to grade yet. R12 is still in progress (only Beşiktaş–Real Madrid tonight), so it will be scored on the next run. So far it's going well, at about 168 with Feliz to come. Vezenkov's 41 as captain (82 doubled, plus the win bonus) is the captain call working, and both of last report's open checks came good: Kamenjas started his debut (PIR 19, a better role than the 10 I projected) and Masiulis (ZAL) won in OT (+10). Misses: Rogkavopoulos got only 6' (I projected 9 PIR off his GBL game; I'll be slower to trust returns from injury), and Malcolm (6) had a bad night at Dubai. Lesson kept for R13: buy the role-jump bigs early. Kamenjas at 4.8 was the best value buy of the week. Research: 61 searches, 43 pages read, 4 players unverified (Bryant's and DiBartolomeo's Israeli games, Herrera, Diarra, who had no LBA game).
window_plan: Unlimited trades before R14 (21–24 Nov). The rebuild's best plan sells Nunn, Brizuela, Malcolm and Joksimović for Payne, Frisch, Maledon and Marinković, with coach Bartzokas (OLY): about 6.9% a round over R14–R16, against about 2.5% if you keep this squad. Variation A already moves that way (Nunn and Brizuela out, Payne in). In the window, Bryant either stays or funds Maledon, and Malcolm and Joksimović make way for the rest. I agree with the direction, but I'll only take Maledon if he gets through tonight and Friday at full minutes, and Frisch only if he starts again. Nothing has to be bought before the window: the price rises in play (Feliz +0.2) are too small to matter.
